study type: Prospective Observational Cohort Study with a Comparative Control Group
exposure: Perioperative factors (intraoperative body temperature, aortic cross-clamp time, perfusion time, operation time, inotropic score, vasoactive inotropic score, lactate levels)
cohort: The study included 44 neonates with congenital heart defects (CHD) (30 operated, 14 non-operated) and 36 healthy neonates as controls.
finding: Serum BDNF levels were significantly lower preoperatively in neonates with CHD undergoing surgery compared to non-operated patients, but increased during the early 24-72 hour postoperative period, although no significant correlation was found between BDNF levels and cranial USG findings.
